                             MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS
                                                   NOTIFICATION
                                             New Delhi, the 31st July, 2025
                    S.O. 3542(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road
Transport and Highways, S.O.3105 (E).Dated: 02.08.2024, published in Gazette of India,Extraordinary, Part II,
Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956)
(here in after referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for construction,maintenance, management and operation of
NH266.( Karad to Tasgaon) in the stretch of landfrom Km. 25.550 to Km. 43.300 (Tupari to Bambavde) in the
district of Sangli in the state of Maharashtra.
         And whereas the substance of the said notification S.O.3105 (E).Dated: 02.08.2024 has been published in
"The Dainik Sakal" dated 24 August 2024 & “Times of India” Dated 15 August 2024 under sub-section (3) of
section 3A of the said Act;
         And whereas objections filed under section 3-C, considered and settled the same appropriately;
        And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act,the competent authority has
submitted its report to the Central Government;

24                           THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY                               [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)]

         Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose;
         And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section Additional 3D of the said Act, the Central
Government hereby declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the
said Schedule shall vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.
